entries.en: Obtain tufts of miniature mallow from near Lyhe Ghiah.
entries.fr: Cueillir des jeunes pousses de mauve-nuage, près du Lyhe Ghiah
entries.ja: リェー・ギア城付近でを入手

entries.en: Deliver the tufts of miniature mallow to Uin Nee.
entries.fr: Apporter les jeunes pousses de mauve-nuage à Uin Nee
entries.section: Allied Society Quests (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)

entries.en: Oh, hello there, ! Apropos of absolutely nothing, have you ever been to Lyhe Ghiah? It's a most wonderful place, home to a magnificent castle and lovely balls of fluffy mallow that float up and down, to and fro in the gently rustling winds.

風を受けて、上下したり、くるくる回転したりしてるやつよ。

entries.en: Well, I was thinking about what I could do to make the children's dreams that much sweeter, and that's when it hit me with all the force of a giant fluffball! I could fill them with poofy, puffy mallow! Wouldn't that just be the most delightful dream ever? Of course it would!
entries.fr: Devine quoi ? J'ai envie d'en mettre plein dans les rêves que je crée ! Aucun doute que les enfants adoreront voir ces petites boules végétales virevolter dans les airs.
entries.ja:
ワタシ、あの浮草を、夢の中にも、
たくさん浮かばせてみたいと思うの！
見てるだけで、楽しい気分になること請け合いよ！

entries.en: But to do that I'll need tufts of mallow, and I simply couldn't bear to take time out of my dreamspinning duties to flutter all the way over to Lyhe Ghiah! After all, what would the children do without me? It's a good thing you came here to offer your aid! That is why you came here, isn't it?

entries.en: Welcome back! Are those tufts of mallow bursting from your pocket, or are you just happy to see me? Or is it both? It's definitely both, isn't it?

entries.en: I knew I could count on you. And just look at these fluffy little tufts! They might not strike you as much now, but once I've worked my magic, they'll sprout into airy balls of fantastic fluff fleecier than the thickest sheep's wool!
entries.fr: Oui, c'est exactement ce que je voulais ! Ce sont encore que de toutes jeunes pousses, mais je vais les bichonner pour en faire de belles boules duveteuses, aussi grosses que des moutons. Elles seront toutes douces, hi hi !♪
entries.ja:
これこれ、ご苦労さまっ！
今はまだ苗だけど、立派に育った浮草の綿毛って、
羊毛みたいにモッフモフしてて、気持ちいいのよね～♪

entries.en: Yes, my dreamers will just love floating through the sky on massive clouds of mallow! Why, I'd even like to try it myself! Not that there's anything wrong about flying with good old-fashioned wings, of course. All the flitting and fluttering just gets a bit tiring from time to time, that's all. <yawn> I think I've earned myself a rest!

entries.fr: C'est bien beau d'avoir des ailes pour voler, mais tout le monde n'a pas cette chance... Quand ces plantes auront suffisamment grandi, les enfants pourront s'en servir comme monture et virevolter dans leurs rêves. J'ai hâte de voir ça !
entries.ja:
羽で飛ぶのもいいけど、これに乗って、
夢の世界でゆったり浮かぶのも、きっと楽しいに違いないわ！
どうもありがとうね！
